effect_description_eng:
While you have an [TS] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase. Then, you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost.

Link Requirements [Link] [TS] trait: Cost 3 
(Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
